items.exampleEn: You can convert your money into the local currency at the airport.
items.exampleZh: 你可以在機場把錢換成當地的貨幣。

items.exampleEn: The thief fled before the police arrived.
items.exampleZh: 小偷在警察趕到前逃走了。

items.exampleEn: A fox has a long, thick tail.
items.exampleZh: 狐狸有一條又長又粗的尾巴。

items.exampleEn: It is hard to sustain your energy during a long meeting.
items.exampleZh: 在冗長的會議中很難維持精神。

items.exampleEn: Water came in through a crack in the wall.
items.exampleZh: 水從牆上的一道裂縫滲了進來。

items.exampleEn: Popcorn explodes when the corn gets very hot.
items.exampleZh: 玉米粒變得很燙時就會爆開成爆米花。

items.exampleEn: My new glasses need a small adjustment because they slide down my nose.
items.exampleZh: 我的新眼鏡會從鼻子上滑下來，需要稍微調整。

items.exampleEn: The players walked onto the pitch to loud cheers.
items.exampleZh: 球員們在熱烈的歡呼聲中走進球場。

items.sentenceEn: The farmers converted the old barn into a small cafe.
items.sentenceZh: 農夫們把舊穀倉改成了一間小咖啡館。

items.audioEn: The cat fled under the bed as soon as the fireworks started.
items.audioZh: 煙火一開始，貓就逃到床底下去了。
items.questionZh: 煙火一開始，貓做了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: After a few small adjustments, the old clock worked perfectly again.
items.sentenceZh: 經過幾個小調整後，那座老鐘又走得很準了。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful: the ice on the lake has started to crack.
items.sentenceZh: 小心，湖面上的冰已經開始裂了。

items.stemEn: The puppy chased its own ____ around in circles.
items.stemZh: 小狗繞著圈圈追自己的尾巴。

items.stemEn: The small farm cannot ____ a family of six without other income.
items.stemZh: 沒有其他收入的話，這座小農場養不起一家六口。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, our town's football team played its most important game of the year. Before the match, workers upgraded the lights, made a few adjustments to the old pitch and filled a long crack near one of the goals, and the mayor pitched a ball into the crowd for fun. In the middle of the game, a dog ran onto the field with its tail in the air, and the crowd exploded with laughter. Last year, the coach converted our best defender into a goalkeeper, and today he saved two difficult shots. The team could not sustain its early lead, and the game ended in a draw. When heavy rain started, some fans fled to their cars and missed the best moments.
items.passageZh: 上週六，我們鎮上的足球隊踢了今年最重要的一場比賽。賽前，工人升級了球場照明，稍微整修了老球場，把一個球門附近的長裂縫補好，市長還好玩地把一顆球拋向觀眾。比賽進行到一半，一隻狗翹著尾巴跑進場內，全場觀眾大笑。教練去年把我們最好的後衛改成守門員，他今天擋下了兩記很難的射門。球隊沒能保住一開始的領先，比賽最後以平手收場。下起大雨時，有些球迷逃回車上，錯過了最精采的時刻。

questions.questionZh: 比賽進行到一半時發生了什麼事？

items.promptZh: 孩子們看著煙火在河面上空爆開。
referenceEn: The children watched the fireworks explode over the river.
The children watched as fireworks exploded above the river.
rubricZh: watch 後面接原形或分詞都可以（例如 watched the fireworks explode、watched … exploding 等）
時態合理（例如 watched 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 crack 造一個句子，說說你身邊有什麼東西有裂縫或裂開了。
referenceEn: There is a long crack in my phone screen.
My favorite cup cracked when I washed it in hot water.
rubricZh: crack 可當名詞或動詞（例如 a crack in…、cracked 等）
時態配合內容（例如 is、cracked 等）

In the middle of the game, a dog ran onto the field with its tail in the air, and the crowd exploded with laughter. Our goalkeeper, who was converted from a defender last year, saved two difficult shots. The team could not sustain its early lead, and the game ended in a draw. Some fans fled the rain before the end and missed the best moments."；改後："Last Saturday, our town's football team played its most important game of the year. Last year, the coach converted our best defender into a goalkeeper, and today he saved two difficult shots. The team could not sustain its early lead, and the game ended in a draw. When heavy rain started, some fans fled to their cars and missed the best moments."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：題目問「比賽中為什麼球員必須停下來？」，但短文只說狗跑進場、觀眾大笑，沒有提到比賽或球員停下來；題目前提在文中找不到。建議改問「比賽進行到一半發生了什麼事？」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 同題修正紀錄。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似不自然："Our goalkeeper, who was converted from a defender last year" 用被動 converted from 指人轉位置較生硬，常見說法是 "who switched from defender to goalkeeper" 或 "a former defender"；"fled the rain" 也略牽強（較自然為 left early to escape the rain）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 同題修正紀錄。
